title: LMEG-Doc: Layout-Grounded Multi-View Evidence Graphs for Multimodal Long-Document Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.18901v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieving relevant evidence from multimodal long documents remains challenging, as supporting information is often distributed across different pages and modalities. Existing retrieval methods primarily rank document elements by their individual similarity to a question, often overlooking relationships among complementary evidence. Consequently, relevant figures and tables may receive low retrieval scores even when they contain essential information. To address this limitation, we introduce LMEG-Doc, a layout-grounded multi-view evidence graph framework for multimodal long-document retrieval. We first construct an evidence graph that captures structural and contextual relationships among document elements, and introduce Cross-Page Relation Refinement (CRR) to discover additional connections across distant pages through VLM-based verification. translated_title: LMEG-Doc：面向多模态长文档检索的基于版面的多视角证据图
translated_abstract: 从多模态长文档中检索相关证据仍然具有挑战性，因为支持信息往往分布在不同的页面和模态之中。现有的检索方法主要根据文档元素与问题之间的个体相似度进行排序，往往忽略了互补证据之间的关系。因此，即使相关的图表包含关键信息，也可能获得较低的检索分数。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了LMEG-Doc，一个面向多模态长文档检索的基于版面的多视角证据图框架。我们首先构建一个证据图来捕捉文档元素之间的结构和上下文关系，并引入跨页关系精炼（Cross-Page Relation Refinement, CRR），通过基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的验证来发现远距离页面之间的额外连接。在此图的基础上，我们将多模态检索信号与图引导的相关性传播相结合。
tldr: 提出LMEG-Doc框架，通过构建基于版面的多视角证据图并引入跨页关系精炼机制，捕捉多模态长文档中跨页面、跨模态互补证据之间的关系，从而提升多模态长文档检索的效果。
en_tdlr: LMEG-Doc proposes a layout-grounded multi-view evidence graph framework with cross-page relation refinement to capture relationships among complementary evidence across pages and modalities, improving multimodal long-document retrieval.
